asset: MetaHuman General Store clerk, Mr. Josiah Trethewey (metahuman-store-clerk)
tool: MetaHuman Creator in Unreal Engine 5.8 (MetaHumanCharacter plugin), scripted through the editor MCP server
license: Unreal Engine EULA (MetaHumans are covered by the Unreal Engine EULA from UE 5.6; no separate MetaHuman licence). See https://www.metahuman.com/license and https://www.unrealengine.com/eula

The EULA restricts using MetaHuman characters or animation data to train or feed generative AI. Do not do that with these assets.

source.startingPreset: Epic MetaHuman Creator stock preset /MetaHumanCharacter/Optional/Presets/Walter, duplicated and edited by Content/Python/homestead_agent/metahuman_clerk.py
source.rig: Epic MetaHuman cloud auto-rigging, requested from the editor with Jenny's Epic sign-in
source.textures: Epic MetaHuman cloud texture sources at 2K (RES2K; one NPC seen at counter distance)
source.grooms: Epic stock grooms: Hair_S_SlickBack, Beard_M_MuttonChops (greyer than the hair), eyebrows, eyelashes; no moustache, no peach fuzz
source.outfit: Project-authored: Assets/Characters/ClerkClothing (shirt, waistcoat, trousers, apron, neckerchief, boots, pencil) from Scripts/Blender/Recipes/clerk_outfit.py with numpy-synthesized textures, skinned to metahuman_base_skel, imported by Scripts/Characters/import_clerk_garments.py. Walter's stock outfit is not used.

animation.origin: Project-authored: keyed on the clerk's own MetaHuman Control Rig by Content/Python/homestead_agent/clerk_counter_idle.py (rig_authoring library) and baked to his skeleton. No third-party animation data.

runtime: AHomesteadShopkeeper (Source/SurvivalGame/HomesteadShopkeeperMetaHuman.cpp): body + face with ABP_Face, leader-posed garments, four grooms without simulation, LODSync over 4 LODs, OnlyTickPoseWhenRendered. Falls back to the stand-in heroine body if the clerk's body or face is missing.
